record.rationale: Format-neutral browser platform code owns package storage transactions and scheduling callbacks while suite-specific models,filters,history and medium semantics remain with their actual source owners.
responsibilities: TaskFJTKAS connects actual Calc ODS packages and ScDocShell lifecycle/history to shared primary browser storage and Writer autosave policy. Open imports into a separate real ScDocument and adopts it only while request/content generation remain current. Replacement resets actual view/history ownership and ends displaced formula subscriptions. Confirmed Save/SaveAs captures source model,medium,generation and shared SfxUndoSavePosition;later edits remain dirty and stale/failed/closed completions cannot adopt a destination. The first two displayed scalar words in native row-major sheet order name an untitled browser document,matching Writer first-two-word naming;empty documents are excluded. Stored bodies are complete existing ODS packages,not alternate workbook JSON. No recovery UI/storage is introduced.

stackDivergence.rationale: IndexedDB and DOM input/timing replace desktop persistence transport;Writer intentional primary-save behavior is retained.
